name: agent-kit
description: Command shortcuts for this Rush monorepo. It is not a Rush project and has no dependencies.

scripts.change:verify: node common/scripts/install-run-rush.js change --verify && node scripts/release-intent.ts check
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run build && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run check:package
scripts.version-packages: node common/scripts/install-run-rush.js version --bump --version-policy main && node common/scripts/install-run-rush.js update
